setup.title: Setup Instructions

download.title: Download & install
download.description: Download the companion app for your platform and run the installer.

run.title: Launch the companion app
run.description: Open the installed companion app. A setup wizard will appear on first launch.

url.title: Enter your Attraccess server URL
url.description: When prompted, enter the URL of this Attraccess server.

register.title: Automatic registration
register.description: The companion app registers itself — it will appear in the "Registered Devices" table above.

name.title: Name the device
name.description: Click Rename in the table to give the device a recognisable name.

flow.title: Add a flow node
flow.description: Go to the resource whose flow should control this PC → open the Flows tab → add a "Lock PC" or "Unlock PC" node and select this device.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete device
deleteConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete <bold>{{name}}</bold>? Its token will be revoked and any active connection will be terminated.
